build_from_cfg: build a module instance from a config dict and Registry by specifying the type key
register_module: register a class or function into a Registry using the register_module decorator or direct call
create_registry: create a new Registry instance with a name and optional parent registry for hierarchical module lookup
call_from_cfg: call a function with arguments extracted from a config dict matching the function signature
callable_from_cfg: wrap a function so it can be called with a config dict as its first argument
